FabricationProcess.Technology: N3P for the 8 accelerator complex dies (XCDs), N6 for the 2 I/O dies (IODs)

Chip.Description: One Instinct MI350-series OAM package: 8 XCDs 3D-stacked in pairs of 4 on top of 2 IODs, plus 8 HBM3E stacks, 185 billion transistors total. 256 active compute units, 16384 stream processors and 1024 Matrix Cores. Primary device modelled here is the liquid-cooled MI355X (up to 2.4 GHz, 1400 W TBP); the air-cooled MI350X is the same silicon at up to 2.2 GHz and 1000 W TBP, giving proportionally ~9% lower peak throughput at identical memory capacity and bandwidth. Eight packages form a fully connected Infinity Fabric platform

XCD.Description: Accelerator Complex Die built on TSMC N3P. Each XCD holds 36 physical compute units of which 32 are active (4 disabled for yield), a shared command processor and workgroup dispatcher, and 4 MB of L2 cache. Down from 38 active CUs per XCD on CDNA 3 / MI300X, offset by higher clocks

Compute Unit.Description: CDNA 4 compute unit: 4 SIMD16 vector units, 4 Matrix Cores, 1 scalar unit, 160 KB of LDS and 32 KB of L1 vector cache. Executes wavefronts of 64 work-items, up to 8 waves per SIMD (32 per CU). Delivers 128 FP32 lanes worth of throughput per clock via packed FP32 dual-issue, and half that for FP64

SIMD.Description: 16-lane vector ALU; a wave64 is issued over 4 cycles. Backed by a 128 KB vector register file (512 32-bit VGPRs per lane) that is unified between architected VGPRs and accumulation AGPRs

Matrix Core.Description: Matrix multiply engine executing the MFMA/SMFMAC instruction family. CDNA 4 roughly doubles per-CU matrix throughput versus CDNA 3 for low precision and adds the OCP block-scaled MXFP6 and MXFP4 formats alongside OCP FP8 (E4M3/E5M2), BF16, FP16, FP32, FP64 and INT8. New gfx950 shapes include v_mfma_f32_16x16x128_f8f6f4 and v_mfma_f32_32x32x64_f8f6f4 (with v_mfma_scale_* and v_mfma_ld_scale_b32 for per-block scales), plus wider FP16/BF16/INT8 shapes; SMFMAC provides 2:4 structured sparsity acceleration. Notably FP6 runs at the same rate as FP4 on CDNA 4. The XF32/TF32 MFMA instructions of CDNA 3 (gfx942) are NOT present on gfx950

Scalar Unit.Description: Per-CU scalar ALU handling wave-uniform arithmetic, control flow and scalar memory (constant) fetches

IOD.Description: I/O die on TSMC N6. Each IOD hosts 4 of the 8 XCDs stacked above it and 4 of the 8 HBM3E stacks, and carries 128 MB of Infinity Cache plus the Infinity Fabric switching. IOD-to-IOD bisection bandwidth is 5.5 TB/s

HBM3E Stack.Description: 12-high HBM3E stack, 36 GB each, on a 1024-bit interface at 8 Gbps per pin. 8 stacks give 288 GB at 8 TB/s aggregate

Infinity Fabric Link.Description: One of 7 4th-generation Infinity Fabric peer-to-peer links, each 16 bits wide at 38.4 Gbps, for 1075.2 GB/s of aggregate GPU-to-GPU bandwidth in an 8-way fully connected platform

PCIe Controller.Description: PCIe 5.0 x16 host interface controller on the OAM module

VGPR.description: 512 32-bit vector registers per lane across 64 lanes = 128 KB per SIMD, 512 KB per CU. The file is unified: a wave can use up to 512 architected VGPRs, or split the space between architected VGPRs and accumulation AGPRs (up to 256 of each)

LDS.description: 160 KB software-managed Local Data Share per compute unit, up from 64 KB on CDNA 3 — the single largest occupancy-relevant change in CDNA 4. Read bandwidth doubled to 256 bytes per clock, GLOBAL_LOAD_LDS widened to 128 bits per lane, and new read-with-transpose instructions feed the Matrix Cores directly. Total 40 MB across 256 CUs

L1 Vector Cache.description: 32 KB per-CU vector L1 data cache, unchanged from CDNA 3

L2.description: 4 MB L2 cache per XCD, coherent across all 8 XCDs; 32 MB total per package. CDNA 4 improves L2 writeback handling of dirty data

Infinity Cache.description: 128 MB of memory-attached last-level Infinity Cache per IOD, 256 MB total, sitting in front of HBM3E and shared by all XCDs

HBM3E.description: 288 GB of HBM3E across 8 12-high stacks at 8 Gbps per pin, 8 TB/s peak bandwidth over an aggregate 8192-bit interface (1024 bits per stack). Identical on MI350X and MI355X

LLVMFeatures.Name: gfx950-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Additional instructions for GFX950+; umbrella feature that implies the permlane swap, arithmetic-shift-pack, block-scaled FP8/BF8/FP6/BF6/FP4 conversion and minimum3/maximum3 features below

LLVMFeatures.Name: mai-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has mAI instructions - the MFMA/SMFMAC matrix arithmetic family executed on the Matrix Cores

LLVMFeatures.Name: fp8-cvt-scale-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has fp8 conversion scale instructions, used for block-scaled OCP MXFP8 (E4M3/E5M2) data

LLVMFeatures.Name: fp6bf6-cvt-scale-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has fp6 and bf6 conversion scale instructions, new in CDNA 4 for the MXFP6 format

LLVMFeatures.Name: fp4-cvt-scale-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has fp4 conversion scale instructions, new in CDNA 4 for the MXFP4 format

LLVMFeatures.Name: permlane16-swap
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_permlane16_swap_b32 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: permlane32-swap
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_permlane32_swap_b32 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: ashr-pk-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has Arithmetic Shift Pack instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: fp8-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has fp8 and bf8 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: ocp-fp8-conversion-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has OCP fp8 (E4M3FN, E5M2) conversion instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: bf16-cvt-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has bf16 conversion instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: bitop3-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_bitop3_b32/v_bitop3_b16 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: prng-inst
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_prng_b32 pseudo-random number generation instruction

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot12-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot2_f32_bf16 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: dot13-insts
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has v_dot2c_f32_bf16 instructions

LLVMFeatures.Name: packed-fp32-ops
LLVMFeatures.Description: Has packed FP32 dual-issue instructions (v_pk_fma_f32 and friends), giving 128 FP32 lanes of throughput per CU

LLVMFeatures.Name: wavefrontsize64
LLVMFeatures.Description: Fixed 64 work-items per wavefront, implied by the GFX9 feature set. CDNA targets have no wave32 mode and cumode/WGP selection does not apply

LLVMFeatures.Name: sramecc
LLVMFeatures.Description: SRAM ECC protection over register files, LDS and caches. Part of the target ID (e.g. gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) and affects VGPR allocation granularity

LLVMFeatures.Name: xnack
LLVMFeatures.Description: Page-fault recovery support enabling unified/shared virtual memory between host and device. Part of the target ID

LLVMFeatures.Name: tgsplit
LLVMFeatures.Description: Enable threadgroup split execution, allowing a workgroup's waves to be distributed across compute units

LLVMFeatures.Name: kernarg-preload
LLVMFeatures.Description: Hardware supports preloading of kernel arguments into user SGPRs

PowerStates.Name: Active
PowerStates.Description: All 256 CUs and 8 HBM3E stacks active. MI355X is rated at 1400 W TBP with up to a 2.4 GHz peak engine clock and requires liquid cooling; the air-cooled MI350X is rated at 1000 W TBP with up to a 2.2 GHz peak engine clock. AMD publishes peak engine clock only; no base clock is published for Instinct parts

PowerStates.Name: Idle
PowerStates.Description: Reduced power state when no workloads are resident
